deploybot: PROD deploy started for commit `e4a2b9c` (tag: `release/v3.6.0`) to prod-us-west-2.

deploy details: initiated by alex. change window 2026-03-20 02:00-03:00 UTC. pinned image: `redwood-inference:3.6.0`. Canary 5% -> 100% over 20m. safeguard policy: auto-rollback on error-rate > 2% or latency p95 increase > 200ms. release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/3.6.0

alex: starting cutover now, will watch canary metrics. @maya oncall FYI.

maya: ack, monitoring dashboards up. will post if anything odd.

deploybot: canary promoted to 5% at 2355554480. telemetry looks normal.

sam: seeing a small 503 spike on inference-runtime canary shard (3 requests). investigating traces.

jia: tailing logs: `inference/serve` shows 503s with `kvcache-miss` for a host. brief snippet:
```
2026-03-20T02:07:12Z inference/serve ERROR request_id=... status=503 reason="kvcache-miss-timeout"
```

alex: keep canary at 5% pause. don't promote until root cause known. @deploybot hold.

deploybot: traffic hold applied. promotion paused at canary=5%.

sam: root cause seems to be a misrouted cache shard, patch ready. patch will fix routing table (PR #5123). recommends promote after patch.

maya: if patch ETA >10m we should consider rollback to avoid customer impact.

alex: apply patch to canary now, then re-run promotion checks. patch applied at 2355554625.

deploybot: canary replaced with patched instances, running smoke checks.

deploybot: smoke checks pass. canary 5% monitors nominal. promoting to 50%.

ops-bot: alert suppressed for 503 spike; resume once stable.

sam: monitoring TS shows error rate back to baseline. approve full rollout.

deploybot: staged shift to 100% complete at 2355554750. prod deploy COMPLETE for `release/v3.6.0` (commit `e4a2b9c`). duration ~5m.

alex: nice work team. no rollback. tagging release and publishing release notes.

maya: monitoring good. will leave for ramp and close out.
